items.details:
Use Solid Eye's night-vision mode and inspect suspicious shapes in the laboratory: the opponent can blend into surfaces and imitate familiar objects or people. Confirm the target before firing. After attacking, move away from the counterattack and check the room again instead of assuming she stayed in the same place.

For the collectible doll, the armored Beast phase must be defeated by stamina depletion using nonlethal damage; inspect the room when the Beauty phase begins. The usable OctoCamo face equipment, the small collectible doll and the Beauty FaceCamo reward are separate things. A nonlethal Beauty finish concerns the face reward, not the earlier doll condition.

details_i18n.en:
Use Solid Eye's night-vision mode and inspect suspicious shapes in the laboratory: the opponent can blend into surfaces and imitate familiar objects or people. Confirm the target before firing. After attacking, move away from the counterattack and check the room again instead of assuming she stayed in the same place.

For the collectible doll, the armored Beast phase must be defeated by stamina depletion using nonlethal damage; inspect the room when the Beauty phase begins. The usable OctoCamo face equipment, the small collectible doll and the Beauty FaceCamo reward are separate things. A nonlethal Beauty finish concerns the face reward, not the earlier doll condition.
details_i18n.pt:
Use a visão noturna do Solid Eye e examine formas suspeitas no laboratório: a adversária pode se camuflar nas superfícies e imitar objetos ou pessoas conhecidas. Confirme o alvo antes de atirar. Depois do ataque, afaste-se da resposta e examine a sala novamente, sem presumir que ela ficou no mesmo lugar.

Para obter a figura colecionável, vença a fase Beast com armadura esgotando vigor com dano não letal; procure a figura quando a fase Beauty começar. O equipamento facial OctoCamo, a figura e a FaceCamo Beauty são recompensas diferentes. Terminar Beauty sem matar diz respeito ao rosto, não à condição anterior da figura.

items.details:
Use Solid Eye night vision to inspect footprints and flattened vegetation. Naomi's narrower prints help distinguish her path from the accompanying soldiers. Stop at junctions and compare the outgoing trails instead of following the largest cluster automatically.

Watch for snipers, Claymores and suspicious huts. A familiar voice can be a decoy, so check the surroundings before approaching its source. If the trail becomes unclear, return to the last confirmed fork and inspect it again. This tracking section rewards observation; clearing every guard or running toward every sound is not necessary to reach the destination.

details_i18n.en:
Use Solid Eye night vision to inspect footprints and flattened vegetation. Naomi's narrower prints help distinguish her path from the accompanying soldiers. Stop at junctions and compare the outgoing trails instead of following the largest cluster automatically.

Watch for snipers, Claymores and suspicious huts. A familiar voice can be a decoy, so check the surroundings before approaching its source. If the trail becomes unclear, return to the last confirmed fork and inspect it again. This tracking section rewards observation; clearing every guard or running toward every sound is not necessary to reach the destination.
details_i18n.pt:
Use a visão noturna do Solid Eye para examinar pegadas e vegetação amassada. As marcas mais estreitas de Naomi ajudam a distinguir seu caminho dos soldados que a acompanham. Pare nas bifurcações e compare os rastros, sem seguir automaticamente o grupo maior.

Cuidado com atiradores, Claymores e cabanas suspeitas. Uma voz conhecida pode ser uma distração; examine o entorno antes de se aproximar da origem. Se perder o rastro, volte à última bifurcação confirmada e examine novamente. Este trecho exige observação; não é preciso derrotar todos os guardas ou correr atrás de cada som.

items.title: Follow the resistance member discreetly

title_i18n.pt: Seguir o membro da resistência discretamente

items.description: Keep enough distance to avoid suspicion while maintaining visual contact at street corners.

description_i18n.en: Keep enough distance to avoid suspicion while maintaining visual contact at street corners.
description_i18n.pt: Mantenha distância para não despertar suspeita, sem perder contato visual nas esquinas.

items.details:
Keep the resistance member in sight from behind cover, allowing him room to stop, look around and react to patrols. If he becomes suspicious, fall back rather than moving closer. Quietly neutralizing a blocking patrol can help him continue, but firing into the street risks disrupting the whole route.

At intersections, watch which way he actually turns instead of guessing from the map. If separated, return to the last confirmed location and use the Resistance Signal equipment to narrow the search. Later changes in his appearance do not mean you should abandon the tail. Your task is to follow the same person to the destination, not clear every street.

details_i18n.en:
Keep the resistance member in sight from behind cover, allowing him room to stop, look around and react to patrols. If he becomes suspicious, fall back rather than moving closer. Quietly neutralizing a blocking patrol can help him continue, but firing into the street risks disrupting the whole route.

At intersections, watch which way he actually turns instead of guessing from the map. If separated, return to the last confirmed location and use the Resistance Signal equipment to narrow the search. Later changes in his appearance do not mean you should abandon the tail. Your task is to follow the same person to the destination, not clear every street.
details_i18n.pt:
Mantenha o membro da resistência à vista pela cobertura, dando espaço para ele parar, observar e reagir às patrulhas. Se ficar desconfiado, recue em vez de se aproximar. Neutralizar discretamente uma patrulha que bloqueia a passagem pode ajudá-lo, mas disparar pela rua arrisca interromper a rota inteira.

Nos cruzamentos, veja para onde ele realmente vira, sem adivinhar pelo mapa. Se perder contato, volte ao último ponto confirmado e use o equipamento Resistance Signal para reduzir a busca. Mudanças posteriores na aparência dele não significam abandonar a perseguição. O objetivo é seguir a mesma pessoa ao destino, não limpar todas as ruas.

items.title: Track Crying Wolf in the snow

items.description: Use reconnaissance equipment and cover to locate the opponent while avoiding surrounding patrols.

description_i18n.en: Use reconnaissance equipment and cover to locate the opponent while avoiding surrounding patrols.

items.details:
Use Solid Eye to search through the snow and keep cover between Snake and the surrounding Haven Troopers. Listen for movement and wait for Wolf to expose the operator while preparing a shot. Fire during that opening, then relocate before the reply instead of shooting continuously into the armor.

Check the wind direction: if it flows from Snake toward Wolf, it can carry his scent to her. Reposition or wait for it to change rather than trusting the same hiding place indefinitely. Manage nearby patrols quietly so they do not interrupt each aiming attempt. For the collectible doll, use nonlethal damage to exhaust the armored form's stamina, then check behind Snake when the Beauty phase begins. Tranquilizing only the Beauty phase does not replace that requirement.

details_i18n.en:
Use Solid Eye to search through the snow and keep cover between Snake and the surrounding Haven Troopers. Listen for movement and wait for Wolf to expose the operator while preparing a shot. Fire during that opening, then relocate before the reply instead of shooting continuously into the armor.

Check the wind direction: if it flows from Snake toward Wolf, it can carry his scent to her. Reposition or wait for it to change rather than trusting the same hiding place indefinitely. Manage nearby patrols quietly so they do not interrupt each aiming attempt. For the collectible doll, use nonlethal damage to exhaust the armored form's stamina, then check behind Snake when the Beauty phase begins. Tranquilizing only the Beauty phase does not replace that requirement.
details_i18n.pt:
Use Solid Eye para procurar na neve e mantenha cobertura entre Snake e as Haven Troopers ao redor. Escute os movimentos e espere Wolf expor a operadora ao preparar um disparo. Atire nessa abertura e mude de posição antes da resposta, sem disparar continuamente contra a armadura.

Confira o vento: se ele soprar de Snake em direção a Wolf, pode levar o cheiro até ela. Mude de posição ou espere a direção mudar, sem confiar indefinidamente no mesmo esconderijo. Controle as patrulhas em silêncio para não interromperem cada tentativa de mira. Para obter a figura, esgote o vigor da forma com armadura usando dano não letal e procure atrás de Snake quando Beauty começar. Tranquilizar apenas Beauty não substitui esse requisito.

items.details:
Ordinary damage brings Vamp down but does not by itself stop his recovery. Once you have reduced his bar and he begins getting back up, put the weapon away, select the Syringe and approach from behind for a CQC restraint. Use the displayed item action while holding him to administer it.

Trying to inject from a distance or while he is still actively attacking will not complete this step. If the hold fails, create another opening and retry.

details_i18n.en:
Ordinary damage brings Vamp down but does not by itself stop his recovery. Once you have reduced his bar and he begins getting back up, put the weapon away, select the Syringe and approach from behind for a CQC restraint. Use the displayed item action while holding him to administer it.

Trying to inject from a distance or while he is still actively attacking will not complete this step. If the hold fails, create another opening and retry.
details_i18n.pt:
Dano comum derruba Vamp, mas não impede sozinho a recuperação. Depois de reduzir sua barra e quando ele começar a levantar, guarde a arma, selecione a Seringa e aproxime-se por trás para agarrá-lo com CQC. Use a ação de item indicada enquanto o segura para aplicar a injeção.

Tentar injetar de longe ou enquanto ele ainda ataca não conclui a etapa. Se o agarrão falhar, crie outra abertura e tente novamente.

items.description: Use the machine's available movement and attack options; adapt to distance rather than relying on one weapon.

description_i18n.en: Use the machine's available movement and attack options; adapt to distance rather than relying on one weapon.
description_i18n.pt: Use as opções de movimento e ataque da máquina; adapte-se à distância em vez de depender de uma arma só.

items.details:
Use REX's boost to change distance quickly instead of walking under sustained fire. At close range, use the available physical attacks to interrupt RAY and create a follow-up opportunity. At longer range, use the displayed ranged weapon options and move again before the enemy can maintain a clear shot.

Do not tunnel-vision on the reticle: check the machines' relative positions and avoid staying against arena edges where movement is restricted. This is a vehicle duel with its own controls; Snake's normal weapon inventory is not the solution. Learn the on-screen control legend and alternate movement with attacks rather than holding one firing position.

details_i18n.en:
Use REX's boost to change distance quickly instead of walking under sustained fire. At close range, use the available physical attacks to interrupt RAY and create a follow-up opportunity. At longer range, use the displayed ranged weapon options and move again before the enemy can maintain a clear shot.

Do not tunnel-vision on the reticle: check the machines' relative positions and avoid staying against arena edges where movement is restricted. This is a vehicle duel with its own controls; Snake's normal weapon inventory is not the solution. Learn the on-screen control legend and alternate movement with attacks rather than holding one firing position.
details_i18n.pt:
Use o impulso de REX para mudar de distância rapidamente, sem caminhar sob fogo contínuo. De perto, use os ataques físicos disponíveis para interromper RAY e criar uma oportunidade de sequência. De longe, use as armas exibidas e volte a se mover antes de o inimigo manter uma linha de tiro livre.

Não se concentre apenas na mira: confira a posição das máquinas e evite ficar nas bordas, onde o movimento é limitado. É um duelo de veículos com controles próprios; o inventário normal de Snake não é a solução. Aprenda os comandos na tela e alterne movimento e ataques, sem manter uma posição fixa.

items.details:
First use the Syringe on Snake to break the interference affecting him. Aim manually at the red Mantis Doll held by the boss rather than spending ammunition on her protected body. When the doll falls, collect it and equip it as a usable weapon. Target the boss with it and follow the displayed movement or shake action after the hit.

The Mantis Doll controls living targets; the Sorrow Doll concerns dead targets and is not the required boss-finishing tool. Both are different from the small Screaming Mantis collectible figure. Avoid killing controlled allies while creating an opening, and inspect the arena before finishing the Beauty phase if collecting the figure.

details_i18n.en:
First use the Syringe on Snake to break the interference affecting him. Aim manually at the red Mantis Doll held by the boss rather than spending ammunition on her protected body. When the doll falls, collect it and equip it as a usable weapon. Target the boss with it and follow the displayed movement or shake action after the hit.

The Mantis Doll controls living targets; the Sorrow Doll concerns dead targets and is not the required boss-finishing tool. Both are different from the small Screaming Mantis collectible figure. Avoid killing controlled allies while creating an opening, and inspect the arena before finishing the Beauty phase if collecting the figure.
details_i18n.pt:
Primeiro use a Seringa no próprio Snake para interromper a interferência que o afeta. Mire manualmente no boneco Mantis vermelho segurado pela chefe, sem gastar munição no corpo protegido. Quando o boneco cair, recolha-o e equipe-o como arma utilizável. Acerte a chefe com ele e siga o comando de movimento ou sacudida exibido após o acerto.

O boneco Mantis controla alvos vivos; o Sorrow atua sobre mortos e não é a ferramenta necessária para terminar a luta. Ambos são diferentes da figura colecionável Screaming Mantis. Evite matar aliados controlados ao criar uma abertura e examine a arena antes de concluir Beauty se estiver coletando a figura.

description_i18n.en: Follow the on-screen movement and action prompts through the entire sequence.

items.details:
Keep following the movement prompts as Snake's condition deteriorates, then repeatedly press the indicated action button when the sequence requires it. On the original PS3 controls this is the Triangle prompt. Continue responding until the game clearly advances; a slow crawl or apparent collapse does not mean the input sequence has ended.

Watch Snake's part of the split-screen without assuming the other panels are interactive targets. The important task is maintaining the required input through the corridor, not opening the weapon menu or finding an alternate route. If the attempt fails, retry from the available checkpoint and begin the repeated input promptly.

details_i18n.en:

The important task is maintaining the required input through the corridor, not opening the weapon menu or finding an alternate route. details_i18n.pt:
Continue seguindo os comandos de movimento enquanto a condição de Snake piora e aperte repetidamente a ação indicada quando a sequência exigir. Nos controles originais do PS3, aparece o comando Triângulo. Continue até o jogo avançar claramente; rastejar devagar ou aparentar desabar não significa que a sequência de comandos terminou.

Observe a parte de Snake na tela dividida sem presumir que os outros painéis sejam alvos interativos. O importante é manter o comando exigido durante o corredor, não abrir o menu de armas ou buscar outro caminho. Se falhar, retome pelo checkpoint disponível e comece prontamente a repetição do comando.
